ns2:course.label: Elementary Organic Chem II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of CHEM 232 focuses on organic chemistry and its applications to biochemistry, enzyme mechanisms and the life sciences. This course should not be taken by students who have completed CHEM 236. Students may not receive credit for both CHEM 332 and CHEM 436. Prerequisite: CHEM 232 and CHEM 233.
